messages:
alisa: kicking off auriga9b-lite int4 canary on g5.2x pool, notes below. low-key worried about long generations causing KV blowup.

jamal: saw OOM on first smoke — generation ~180 tokens. stack points at kv cache ballooning, not model weights.

tomo: paste logs: 
```
2026-03-21T14:02:11Z ERROR runtime: CUDA OOM when allocating 1.2GB for kv_cache
call stack: ... runtime/kv_cache.cc:142
last user op: generate(token=169)
```

ana: (sorry) also noticed quality dip after int4 qconfig v3.2 — perplexing but could be quant noise at tail.

alisa: plan proposal: 1) reduce default max_new_tokens for auriga9b-lite from 256 -> 96 for canary. 2) disable aggressive prefetch for this model. 3) soft-kv-evict: trim older keys once kv_util > 0.6. 4) microbatch tuning: min_batch_tokens 48, window_ms 10. 5) add perf/quality evals post-rollout.

jamal: +1 for lowering max_new_tokens. Large tails are rare in product and cost us frag. Where do we set these? model config or routing policy?

alisa: model config for now so canary captures behavior. will push a patch to model catalogue: `models/auriga9b-lite/config.json` (canary key).

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: auriga9b-lite-int4-canary -> pool-g5-2x at 2026-03-21T15:00 UTC (job id: deploy-auriga-canary-172111).

ana: small correctness note: we should run the eval suite with 3 seeds for BLEU/ROUGE-ish metrics + 50 summarization prompts to catch subtle regressions. I can hook up the eval harness.

alisa: done. eval harness job queued. config patch below — will apply to canary only:
```
{
  "model": "auriga9b-lite",
  "quant": "int4-v3.2",
  "defaults": {
    "max_new_tokens": 96,
    "streaming": true,
    "prefetch": false
  },
  "batching": {
    "min_batch_tokens": 48,
    "max_batch_window_ms": 10,
    "adaptive_window": true
  },
  "kv_policy": {
    "soft_trim_threshold": 0.6,
    "evict_margin": 0.15
  }
}
```

jamal: one more tweak: set per-request max_tokens_hard_limit to 512 at the router so no runaway client can request insane tails during canary.

alisa: agreed — routing policy updated. also adding telemetry flags: kv_size_bytes, kv_trim_events, batch_effective_latency.

ana: eval results after 30m run: quality delta vs fp16 baseline: mean ROUGE-L -0.7%, pass rate 92/100 prompts (baseline 95/100). Not great but in acceptable range for now; will annotate failing prompts.

tomo: memory side: after enabling soft_trim and prefetch=false we saw kv occupancy peak down ~35% and no OOMs in 2h stress with synthetic tails. latency median +6ms.

alisa: recommendation: continue canary for 24h, run wider perf comparison (g5.2x vs g5.4x), if stable roll to 10% traffic, and schedule quant-eval follow-up to try int4-v3.3 (different per-layer scale) to regain small quality gap.

jamal: +1. can we add a fallback policy to route to auriga9b-fp16 if kv_trim events > 50/min?

infra-bot: feature note: we have `fallback_on_kv_pressure` toggle; can enable per-route.

alisa: enabling fallback_on_kv_pressure for canary at 10% threshold. will post final roll plan in #eng-releases if canary passes. :thumbsup:

ana: adding the failing prompts to the regression dashboard now. will post a short summary in 3h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jamal: thanks all — good playbook. saved the config as `172111-auriga-canary-v1` in the model catalog.

alisa: closing loop here, will update if any OOMs crop up.
